landing.hero.eyebrow: Agricultural intelligence, not a farming template
landing.hero.headline: Smarter Decisions. Better Harvests.
landing.hero.sub: AgriSmart brings live mandi prices, weather, AI-assisted crop health and a working marketplace into one platform for farmers and buyers — no invented numbers, ever.
landing.market.title: Live mandi prices, not guesses
landing.market.body: Minimum, maximum and modal prices pulled directly from the Government of India's data.gov.in mandi dataset, filterable by commodity, state, district and market, with historical trend charts. If the source is unavailable, the page says so — it never fills the gap with fabricated numbers.
landing.health.title: Photo-based crop analysis, honestly scoped
landing.health.body: Upload a photo and describe the symptoms; the assistant returns a possible issue, severity, plain-language explanation and recommended actions. It's decision support, not a certified diagnosis, and it's deliberately never allowed to report a confidence score it can't back up.
landing.weather.title: Conditions that matter for the field
landing.weather.body: Current conditions and a 5-day forecast from OpenWeather — temperature, humidity, wind, pressure and visibility — with agricultural context layered on top, not invented on top.
landing.diary.title: A field journal that's actually searchable
landing.diary.body: Log observations by crop and date, attach a photo, then search and filter your own history later — a running record instead of a notebook that gets left in a bag.
landing.assistant.title: Ask it about your farm, not just farming
landing.assistant.body: The assistant can reach into your live market, weather and crop data through tools when it answers — fertilizer, pests, prices, care — and it says when it doesn't know rather than filling in a plausible-sounding guess.
landing.voice.title: Built for more than one language from day one
landing.voice.body: Voice search and full English/Hindi localization ship today; the architecture is ready for more languages as real translations become available — nothing gets machine-guessed into the UI.
landing.ecosystem.title: One marketplace, two sides
landing.ecosystem.body: Farmers list produce and track inquiries; buyers search, save and contact sellers directly. Admins get live user and activity counts, not sample data.
landing.cta.title: Bring real data to your next decision
landing.cta.body: Create an account as a farmer or buyer, or sign in if you already have one.
